༁ྃ:dpal rta mgrin gnyen po lha lnga snyan brgyud snying po'i yang zhun bzhugs so::

tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ: dpal rta mgrin gnyen po lha lnga snyan brgyud snying po'i yang zhun bzhugs so: :

༁ྃ: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: e ma skal ldan pad+ma'i bu: bstan 'gro'i don chen sgrub pa legs: 'on kyang mtha' dmag gdug pa yi: gnyen po las la sbyar ba'i tshe: nags phyogs gza' klu rgyal gsum dang : bdud bzhi'i tshogs rnams rab tu 'khrugs: glo bur tshe la bar chad 'byung : de rnams gnyen po stobs kyi lha: o rgyan bdag gi thugs bcud 'di: yal bar ma dor nyams su long : rang gzhan don chen 'grub par nges: sa ma ya: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshogs bsag dang : bgegs bskrad mtshams gcod byin rlabs sogs: las rim spyi ltar sngon 'gro bas: dngos gzhi bskyed pa'i rim pa ni: hūm̐: de bzhin nyid dbyings ma bcos 'od gsal gdangs: dmigs med brtse ba'i cho 'phrul hūm̐ mthing ga'i: rig rtsal rol pas snod bcud stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang nas mkha' las 'ja' tshon ltar: 'byung ba rim brtsegs rdo rje'i ri rab dang : mi phyed srung 'khor dur khrod gzhal med dbus: sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang : bdud bzhi dregs pa gza' klu rgyal 'gong sogs: 'dar zhing 'dud pa byi chings bsnol ba'i steng : rig pa hūm̐ las bdag nyid rtsa ba'i lha: rig 'dzin 'chol ba'i khro rgyal gro bo lod: yak+sha kā la dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal: sku mdog dus mtha'i char sprin 'khrugs pa'i mdangs: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum dmar la zlum: sma ra smin ma ag tshom me ltar 'bar: khro gnyer rab bsdus ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrogs: dar nag ber gsol dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rwa dgu pa: sdigs pa'i mdzub mos nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgrengs: rtse las gdug pa klu gdon 'dul ba'i gnyen: ye shes khyung chen mthing nag khra thabs 'phro: phyag g.yon ri rab phur bu gsol ba las: bar chad bdud 'dul badz+ra kī la ya: ljang nag phur bu 'dril ba rlung ltar 'tshubs: spyi gtsug rta gdong ljang zhur 'tsher ba yis:

'jig rten khams kun shig shig yom yom 'gul: rngog ma dmar po me 'bar thig le'i dbus: pad nyi'i steng du dus min 'chi ba yi: gnyen po'i lha mchog bcom ldan tshe dpag med: khros pa'i skur bzhengs pad+ma he ru ka: phyag g.yas pad+ma dmar pos tshe bcud sdud: g.yon pas tshe bum sgrub la dngos grub stsal: dar dang rin chen rus pa'i phyag rgyas spras: rang 'od yum 'khyud zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs: thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng : ye shes sems dpa' klu gshed gsang ba'i bdag: rdo rje sdigs mdzub mthing nag khro chas rdzogs: rang byung rig pa 'od skur lam mer gsal: bdag nyid rgyal 'gong dam sri 'byung po'i gshed: zhabs zung dor stabs drag me 'khrugs pa'i klong : rab 'byams khro bo'i sprul pa spro zhing bsdu: de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi: gnas gsum rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan: ye shes dbang bskur rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas brgyan: phung khams skye mched khrag 'thung phyag rgyar rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra kā wā tsi āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa su ra ta s+t+waṃ a haṃ: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs gnyen po stobs kyi lha: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i lha tshogs gnas 'dir gshegs: dbang skur byin phob mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba ma hā kro dhā rā dza e h+ye hi: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dzñā na sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hūm̐: dam tshig rten la ye shes gnyis med bzhugs: byang chub bar du ro gcig tiṣ+ṭha lhan: rang las sprul pa'i phyag rgya'i dhā ki nīs: sgo gsum gus pa'i brda yis 'dud phyag 'tshal: a ti pu ho: pra tī ts+tsha ho: hūm̐ḥ gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams tshogs: drag po'i nyer spyod 'dod yon brjid cing rngams: sman raka gtor tshogs sbyor sgrol mchod pa'i sprin: 'bul lo bzhes nas mthu dbang dngos grub stsol:

oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐: pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ hūm̐: khro rgyal kun 'dus gnyen po stobs kyi lha: dus min 'chi dang bdud bzhi'i bar chad 'joms: srog bdag gza' klu rgyal 'gong tshar gcod pa'i: rdo rje 'du 'phro mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar lha sku gsal btab nas: yid mig rlung gsum rtse gcig gtad: kun gzhi ma bcos rig pa'i mdangs: phyag rgya'i gzugs su yang yang brtag: rtog tshogs lha skur thim pa na: rlung gi rgyu ba'ang der thim nas: rlung sems dbyer med gzugs kyi sku'i: gsal brtan gyad du gyur pa'i tshe: gzung 'dzin snang zhen rgyur bcas kyis: de la bar chod byar med na: phyi rol bgegs kyis smros ci dgos: rdo rje'i btsan rdzong grub pa'o: sa ma ya: bzlas pa sngags kyi man ngag gi: ye shes sems dpa' gsang bdag gi: thugs kar nyi steng rdo rje'i sbubs: hūm̐ mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las: 'od 'phros rtsa gsum rab 'byams mchod: 'gro ba kun gyi bar chod bsal: 'chi bdag gdon dang bdud kyi sde: ma rungs gza' klu rgyal 'gong sogs: sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun: dbang du bsdus shing bran du bkol: bsad gzir bskrad mnan chos dbyings bst-ims: thams cad ka dag rig pa'i gdangs: lhun grub dpal gyi phyag rgyar rdzogs: tshur 'dus bdag thim nus stobs 'bar: gnyen po stobs kyi lha lnga dang : dbyer med dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs bsam: spyi dril bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi: bzlas brjod chu bo'i gzhung ltar bya: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hrī: hūm̐ khroṃ kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: so so'i bzlas pa bya 'dod na: spyi bo'i pad+ma he ru ka'i: thugs srog hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rang gi bla tshe chad yar dang : 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bdud rtsir bsdus: zhal zhugs sku yi dbyibs brgyud nas: sbyor mtshams las byung bdag nyid kyi:

spyi bo nas brgyud rtsa khams gang : 'chi med rdo rje'i srog 'grub bsam: oṃ hrīḥpad+ma kro dha badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā: ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka nas: thugs srog hūm̐ mthing thog ltar spros: steng gdon gza' rnams bran du bkol: gdug pa can kun tshar bcad bsam: oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+tān mā ra ya phaṭa: phyag g.yas rdo rje'i rtse mo las: ye shes khyung chen skar ltar 'phros: 'og gdon gdug pa klu yi tshogs: gzir mnan ma rungs tshar bcad bsam: oṃ khroṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa nā ga sarba duṣ+tān hūm̐ phaṭa: phyag g.yon rdo rje gzhon nu las: gnam lcags phur pa ser ltar 'dril: bdud bzhi la sogs bar chad kun: bsad gzir bskrad mnan dbyings bstim bsam: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān mā ra se na bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: spyi dril bsnyen pa 'bum bzhi ste: so so'i rig pa 'bum du bzla: las rnams thams cad rdzogs pa yi: mthu rtsal 'grub par gdon mi za: sa ma ya: rdzogs pa'i rim pa rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni: mi rtag rgyud bskul nges 'byung byang sems sbyang : skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bla mar gsol ba gdab: thugs yid gcig bsres ka dag dgongs pa'i ngang : lhun grub rig rtsal lha sngags sgyu mar sbyang : lus bsrang rlung dal mig 'bras nam mkhar gtad: rig pa ma bcos spro bsdu bral bar bzhag: de tshe dug lnga'i rtog pa ci shar yang : sngon bsu rjes gcod blo yis ma bcos pas: sbrul mdud bzhin du 'gyu dran rang sar grol: gti mug rnam rtog dus min 'chi ba kun: rig stong chos dbyings ye shes ngang du thim: nga rgyal dam sri 'byung po dpung dang bcas: gsal stong mnyam pa nyid du lhun gyis rdzogs: zhe sdang 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i gza' yi gdon: myang stong me long ye shes klong du zhi: 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo ba'i gdug pa'i klu: bde stong so sor rtog pa'i phyag rgyas thebs: phrag dog rlung dmar 'tshubs pa'i bdud kyi sde:

dran stong bya grub ye shes rgyan du shar: skabs su hūm̐ gi glu blangs bden zhen bshig: res 'ga' cir yang mi dmigs stong par sbyang : rnams kun ma yengs mi sgom rig pa'i gzer: chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rtag tu sus goms pa: dug lnga gnas dag gdon lnga rang sar grol: khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i ye shes tshe 'dir rnyed: mi mthun gzung 'dzin g.yul las rnam par rgyal: lhun grub rig 'dzin go 'phang mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: slob ma smin byed dbang bskur gyi: cho ga'i rim pa bsgrub 'dod na: dben par rdzas dang mchod gtor bsham: bskyed bzlas bdag nyid nus ldan bya: de nas gsang ba'i snod rung rnams: khrus nas dbyung zhing 'gal rkyen gsal: mthun rkyen tshogs phyir maṇ+ḍal phul: gus pas gsol ba 'di skad gdab: e ma rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan rigs kyi bu: khrag 'thung gnyen po lha lnga yi: dbang bskur byin rlabs stsal du gsol: zhes zhu rgyud sbyang sdom pa sbyin: dam tshig gsal gdab ye shes brtan: de nas bum pa spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: rin chen bum pa dur khrod gzhal med khang : nang bcud khrag 'thung lha lnga'i phyag rgya'i tshogs: 'od zhu byang sems bdud rtsis dbang bskur bas: rgyud dag ye shes nus rtsal rdzogs par shog: sngags mthar hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka su ra ta s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā miḥ dbang bskur rigs bdag phyag rgyas gdab: ye shes sku las gnyis pa bstim: hūm̐: dpal chen rta mgrin khro bo'i rgyal po yi: rdo rje'i sku yi byin rlabs ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la stsal nas kyang : rgyal 'gong dam sri'i gnyen por grub par shog: badz+ra kro dha ha a grī wa kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: hrīḥ tshe dpag med mgon pad+ma he ru ka'i: rdo rje'i sku= skal ldan= dus min 'chi ba'i gnyen por grub par shog: hrīḥpad+ma kro dha kā ya= hūm̐: bcom ldan gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag po yi:

rdo rje'i sku= skal ldan= dregs pa gza' yi gnyen por= hūm̐ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa kā ya= khroṃ: khro rgyal sprul pa ye shes ga ru ḍa'i: rdo rje'i sku= skal ldan= gdug pa klu yi gnyen por= khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐= hūm̐: phrin las rtsal rdzogs badz+ra kī la ya'i: rdo rje'i= skal ldan= ma rungs bdud bzhi'i gnyen por= hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: bzlas lung sbyin zhing bgrang phreng gtad: āḥ gnyen po stobs 'dus khro rgyal lha tshogs kyi: rdo rje'i gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la stsal nas kyang : nus pa sngags kyi ye shes grub par shog: sngags mthar wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan me long du: gsal bar 'char bas mtshon byas te: hūm̐: khro rgyal rnams kyi stong gsal ye shes dbyings: rdo rje'i thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa: skal ldan slob ma 'di la stsal nas kyang : rang byung dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs par shog: sngags mthar tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: mtha' rten so so'i rdzas byin la: hrīḥ zla gam dmar po 'od kyi thig le ru: tshe bdag mgon po khro bo'i lha tshogs bzhugs: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang skur bas: mi phyed rdo rje'i srog tu yongs grub shog: hrīḥ.ā yur+dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: tshe ril bdud rtsi dag kyang sbyin: hūm̐: srid pa gsum po 'dar zhing g.yo byed pa'i: rta gdong zhal gyi phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas: rdo rje'i rta skad nam mkhar 'tsher ba'i sgras: rgyal 'gong dam sri'i dpung tshogs zil gnon shog: hrīḥha ya grī ba hi hi hi a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: hūm̐: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse dgu la: gsang bdag khro rgyal chen po'i nus mthu rdzogs: gsor ba tsam gyis steng gdon gza' yi tshogs: gzir mnan las la khol ba'i nus stobs shog: hūm̐ badz+ra a bhī ṣiñtsā mi: khroṃ: dug lnga'i rang bzhin klu gdon 'dul ba'i dpal:

'joms byed khyung chen rigs lnga'i ngo bo nyid: gnyen po rdzas kyi ril bu 'di byin pas: gdug pa nā ga'i tshogs rnams tshar gcod shog: khroṃ pañtsa ga ru ḍa a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: hūm̐: phrin las stobs rdzogs badz+ra kī la ya'i: phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs pa'i dbang bskur bas: byang chub lam gyi bar chad ma lus kun: tshar gcod mngon spyod las kun grub par shog: hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: shis brjod dam tshig khas blang sogs: rjes kyi rim pa spyi ltar bya: lta dgongs gding ldan slob dpon gyis: dam tshig dag pa'i slob ma la: dbang 'di lan gcig bskur bas kyang : byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chod kyi: g.yul las rnam par rgyal 'gyur na: bskyed rdzogs lam la brtson pa yis: dngos grub thob pa smos ci dgos: de phyir shin tu gces par zung : sa ma ya: de ltar gnyen po lha lnga'i tshogs: gcig 'dril snying po'i sgrub thabs 'di: sngon chad gzhan du ma bstan pa: lo tsā chen po'i skye ba'i mtha': skal ldan khyod la brtse bas gdams: gzhan la ma spel rang nyams longs: ma 'ongs shin tu rtsub 'gyur dus: gsang ba kun 'dzin pad+ma'i bu: khyod kyi ming dang mthun pa la: snyan brgyud byin rlabs tshul du gdams: snod ldan 'ga' re'i don du 'gyur: sa ma ya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: lo chen bai ro'i thugs sprul rig 'dzin mchog ldan mgon po'am sprul pa'i gter chen o rgyan mdo sngags gling pa la gu ru rin po ches snyan brgyud du stsal ba nyid/ slad char pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa la gter ston nyid kyi skus snyan brgyud du gdams te gtan la phab nas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i brdas bskul ba ltar/ kho bo 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa la smin grol tshang sprugs su stsal te bar chad kyi 'phrang bsal bar mdzad pas bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa'o/ /dge legs 'phel// PAGE PAGE
